metadata.name: SearchAccount
metadata.description: The purpose of this is API is to search the account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Debtor File # or Client Account # Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Condition: At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

request_fields.name: CompanyNumber
request_fields.description: Company Number Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXX Example:1234 Allowable Values: 7

request_fields.name: ApplicationNumber
request_fields.description: Unique Number generated for the Account creation Application . Valid Values:0-9 Example:8002201421

request_fields.name: SearchByCoApplicant
request_fields.description: Flag to decide if Search can be perform by CoApplicant or not. Valid Values: 0 and 1 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: CorporateAccountNumber
request_fields.description: Corporate Account Number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumberLast4Digits
request_fields.description: Last 4 digits of card number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:1234 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Merchant Number which is assgined to a Merchant. Valid Values- 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:11642

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: Card holder's First name. Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:User1 Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Card holder's last name. Valid Values:A-Z Format:XXXXX Example:Smith Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: EmailID
request_fields.description: Card holder  Email ID Format: [email protected] Example: [email protected] Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 256

request_fields.name: DateOfBirth
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Date of Birth Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 02/01/2020

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Card holder Work phone number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXX Example:5678909876 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: MobilePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Mobile Phone Number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:987567757 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: HomePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Card holder Home Phone number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7895463214 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SSNLast4Digits
request_fields.description: Card holder's last four digit of SSN Valid Values:1120 Format:XXXX Example:1120 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: TransactionID
request_fields.description: Transaction Number for transaction being posted. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:23654789

request_fields.name: SecondaryIDNumber
request_fields.description: get or set SecondaryIdNumber Allowable Values: 128

request_fields.name: CustomerID
request_fields.description: Unique ID associated with Customer Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example: abc2123 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CompanyName
request_fields.description: Company Name Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:ABC Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 26

request_fields.name: InvoiceNumber
request_fields.description: Incoice Number for Transaction Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:987567757 Allowable Values: 28

request_fields.name: CustomerType
request_fields.description: This tag reflects the customer type, like Individual, organisation etc Valid Values: 01- Individual 02- Organization 07- Owning Partner 08- Partner Store 09- Purged 10- Register Example: 01 Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: AccountType
request_fields.description: Type of Account / Credit Report Details Account Type Valid Values: 0-Company 1-Cardholder 2-Holding Account 3-Relationship Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Postal code of the card holder's address. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:46206 Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Debtor Address Line 1 Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Condition:This is mandatory only when HoldEmbossing tag value is 0(NO) Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Debtor Address Line 2 Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:Park Avenue Condition:This is mandatory only when HoldEmbossing tag value is 0(NO) and Country selected as Non-US. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: City
request_fields.description: Debtor City Example:Los Angeles Condition: CBR" Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: State
request_fields.description: State of the card holder address. Format:XXXXX Example: MO Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: Country
request_fields.description: Country name of the Card holder's address Example:USA Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: ClientID
request_fields.description: get or set ClientID

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: Product ID Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:1234

request_fields.name: StoreID
request_fields.description: Store ID Valid Values:XXX Format:0-9 Example:1234

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: This Tag Defines how many number of Records will be Fetched in One Batch/Page If User didn’t Input any Value, then the Default Value as per System will be 50 Max Value Inputted can be 500 Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX Example:50 Condition: Default Value will be 50 and Max Value Inputted must not exceed 500

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: This Tag Defines which Page Number of the Index of which the Records must be Fetched Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:12 Condition: Default value would be 0

request_fields.name: ReferenceID
request_fields.description: get or set ReferenceID Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: SearchByCosigner
request_fields.description: Flag to decide if search can be performed by cosigner. Valid Values: 0 and 1 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: MerchantNumberlist
request_fields.description: User can input one or multiple merchant numbers and get the results accordingly. Valid Values- A-Z, 0-9 Example:"1234,2345,3456" Condition: any one search criteria required
